# DNS

The DNS resolvers of each interface of the host.
`osapi dsl behavior get --name dns` and `osapi dsl behavior method get` show the
same. [Its chain](../../../chains/networking/dns.md) shows each call that its
examples make.

## Method get

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | get                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Verb        | read                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Description | Get the DNS resolvers of an interface                                                                                                                                                     |
| Detail      | Reads the servers and the search domains of the interface: resolvectl on Linux, with resolv.conf on a host that has no resolvers per interface, such as a container, and scutil on macOS. |
| HTTP        | GET                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/network/dns/&#123;interface_name&#125;                                                                                                                     |
| Permission  | dns:read                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Command     | [osapi client node network dns get](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/network/dns/get.md)                                                                                                 |
| Input type  | GetInput                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Output type | Entry                                                                                                                                                                                     |

### Input (1)

| FIELD          | TYPE   | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                                                  | DESCRIPTION                                                            |
| -------------- | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| interface_name | string | yes      | pattern ^(@fact\.\[a-z0-9_.]+\|\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9._-]&#123;0,14&#125;)$ | The interface, such as eth0, or a fact such as @fact.interface.primary |

### Output (2)

| FIELD          | TYPE  | DESCRIPTION        |
| -------------- | ----- | ------------------ |
| servers        | array | The DNS servers    |
| search_domains | array | The search domains |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE                                     | INPUT                 | OUTPUT                                                    |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| An interface with servers and a domain      | interface_name=osapi0 | servers=\[1.1.1.1 8.8.8.8], search_domains=\[example.com] |
| A container with no resolvers per interface | interface_name=osapi0 | servers=\[10.0.0.2], search_domains=\[svc.local]          |
| A Mac                                       | interface_name=en0    | servers=\[1.1.1.1], search_domains=\[]                    |

## Method update

|             |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Name        | update                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Verb        | write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Description | Set the DNS resolvers of an interface                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Detail      | Writes a netplan file of the interface's own, such as /etc/netplan/osapi-dns-eth0.yaml for eth0, under the netplan definition that matches the interface, and applies it. A definition that matches several interfaces, such as cloud-init's all for en\*, gives each of them the resolvers. An empty list keeps the interface's servers or domains, and an interface with no resolvers yet starts from none. override_dhcp drops the servers DHCP gives. It runs on the Debian family, and elsewhere, and in a container, reports skipped. |
| HTTP        | PUT                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Route       | /api/node/&#123;hostname&#125;/network/dns/&#123;interface_name&#125;                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Permission  | dns:write                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Command     | [osapi client node network dns update](../../../../usage/cli/client/node/network/dns/update.md)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Input type  | UpdateInput                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Output type | Result                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

### Input (4)

| FIELD          | TYPE    | REQUIRED | CONSTRAINTS                                                                  | DESCRIPTION                                                            |
| -------------- | ------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| interface_name | string  | yes      | pattern ^(@fact\.\[a-z0-9_.]+\|\[a-zA-Z0-9]\[a-zA-Z0-9._-]&#123;0,14&#125;)$ | The interface, such as eth0, or a fact such as @fact.interface.primary |
| servers        | array   | no       |                                                                              | The DNS servers, IPv4 or IPv6; the interface's own when empty          |
| search_domains | array   | no       |                                                                              | The search domains; the interface's own when empty                     |
| override_dhcp  | boolean | no       |                                                                              | Use only these servers: drop the ones DHCP gives                       |

### Output (2)

| FIELD          | TYPE    | DESCRIPTION              |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------------------ |
| interface_name | string  | The interface            |
| changed        | boolean | Whether the host changed |

### Examples (3)

| EXAMPLE                                      | INPUT                                                                     | OUTPUT                              |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Set the servers of an interface              | interface_name=osapi0, servers=\[9.9.9.9]                                 | interface_name=osapi0, changed=true |
| Set the search domains, and keep the servers | interface_name=osapi0, search_domains=\[corp.example], override_dhcp=true | interface_name=osapi0, changed=true |
| An interface with no resolvers yet           | interface_name=osapi0, servers=\[9.9.9.9]                                 | interface_name=osapi0, changed=true |
